source_message.text:
This was not a frontend problem. The contract already sends referralCode=0 through “random referral via VRF”, but the payout and ticket occur only after processRandomReferral(requestId) is called once VRF has fulfilled.
Our backend previously did not listen for VRFFulfilled, so it never sent that follow-up tx, resulting in no ticket and no random commission.
